title: Extension of scalars to $E$ is a localization on bounded constructible complexes
statement:
Let $\ell$ be a prime, let $E\subseteq\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$ be a finite extension of $\mathbf Q_\ell$ with valuation ring $\cO_E$, and let $X$ be a scheme whose underlying topological space is Noetherian. Then the functor
$E\otimes^{\mathrm L}_{\cO_E}-\colon D_{\mathrm{cons}}(X_{\mathrm{proét}},\cO_E)\to
D_{\mathrm{cons}}(X_{\mathrm{proét}},E)$ of [def-sfb-bounded-constructible-extend-scalars]
is a localization functor with respect to the class $W_{\ell^{\mathbf N}}$
[sk-def-sfb-rationalization]. This is the class of morphisms of the triangulated
$\mathbf Z$-linear category $D_{\mathrm{cons}}(X_{\mathrm{proét}},\cO_E)$
[sk-def-sfb-bounded-constructible] whose mapping cone is killed by some power $\ell^n$.

external.place: There $\Hom(K,-)$ is computed by pro-étale cohomology on a quasi-compact quasi-separated scheme (a topologically Noetherian scheme is such), which commutes with filtered colimits (Bhatt–Scholze, §6.8).

proof.text: Give $E$ its induced norm. The actual coefficient inclusion and $L=\operatorname{integralScalarExtension}$ of [def-weil-pbc-continuous-integral-coefficients] identify with [def-sfb-integers-to-subfield]. Let $F$ be [def-sfb-bounded-constructible-extend-scalars]. Its stated compatibility identifies $F$ with $L$ under the full inclusions. The integral source is triangulated by [lem-weil-pbc-padic-integers-bounded-triangulated]. By [det-prop-sfb-qlbar-colimit-x-invert-ell], $E_X$ is a flat $\cO_{E,X}$-module, so $\operatorname{Ext}_\varphi=E_X\otimes_{\cO_{E,X}}-$ preserves short exact sequences of module objects. The exact-functor clause of [sk-def-sfb-derived-categories] identifies $L$ with the termwise functor $D(\operatorname{Ext}_\varphi)$, and [lem-sf-exact-functor-derived-triangulated] makes it additive and triangulated.

By [lem-sfb-rational-derived-scalar-invertible], every $\ell^n\operatorname{id}$ is invertible on ambient rational objects, hence also in the rational full subcategory. If $Z$ is a cone killed by $\ell^n$, additivity gives $\ell^n\operatorname{id}_{LZ}=0$; cancelling this invertible endomorphism gives $\operatorname{id}_{LZ}=0$. The image triangle has zero cone, so [lem-kun-distinguished-cone-zero] makes its first map invertible. Full inclusions reflect inverses, and thus $F$ inverts the class of [sk-def-sfb-rationalization].

For a map $h:FA\to FB$, apply [lem-weil-pbc-continuous-constructible-integral-denominators] through the compatibility of step 1 to get $\ell^nh=F(u)$. For every rational bounded constructible $K$, [lem-weil-pbc-continuous-constructible-integral-model] gives an integral $M$ and $LM\cong K$. This isomorphism and its inverse are morphisms in the full subcategory, so $FM\cong K$ there. Hence $F$ is essentially surjective.

The adjunction $L\dashv U$ is [sk-def-sfb-derived-extension-of-scalars]. The telescope of [def-weil-pbc-integral-localization-telescope] has zeroth leg its unit, since the inverse scalar has exponent zero. At shift zero [lem-sfb-integral-localization-hom-colimit] supplies the Hom colimit required by [lem-sfb-scalar-unit-equality-detection]. Apply it with $a=\ell$: $L(f)=L(g)$ implies $\ell^nf=\ell^ng$. Compatibility and faithfulness of the full inclusions give the same assertion for $F$.

Apply [lem-sfb-rationalization-localization-hom-criterion] with $R=\mathbf Z$ and $M=\{\ell^n:n\geq0\}$. Additivity from step 1 gives integer linearity; step 2 gives inversion of $W_M$ and invertible scalars; step 3 gives denominator lifting and essential surjectivity; step 4 gives scalar detection of equality. The criterion proves precisely the asserted localization property of the unchanged functor $F$.
